field_meaning.hi: 3 से 7 वर्ष की सजा वाले अपराध।

review_objections: Alibaba: The definition is factually incorrect. Under the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 'Serious Offences' are defined as offences punishable with imprisonment of three years or more. There is no upper limit of 7 years in the definition; it includes offences punishable by life imprisonment or death (though the juvenile cannot be sentenced to death, the offence itself is classified as serious if the maximum punishment is 3+ years).
